title: TOPS-20 MX, not a proven electrical UPS
summary: KLH10 documentation connects the recurring 'Waiting for UPS:' text to MX process/Mails context; UPS expansion and mail transmission error are unverified.
invariants: Never infer physical UPS failure from MX console text.
Treat operator mail failure theory as hypothesis.
Avoid touching 7-PTYCON.ATO, deleting MX jobs, or attaching guest power devices without explicit qualification.
Connect Selector, Instrumentation Mesh, Time Service and DEC adapter are not delivered.
